Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The first parts are listed.

Step 2:

  • All 201 parts are listed (the list loads 30 at a time, so this takes 7 loads).

Step 3:

  • The menu opens.

Step 4:

  • Bulk mode turns on.

Step 5:

  • The bar reads 201 selected, and the line under the table reads "201 records selected."

Step 6:

  • The Deactivate button is dimmed (disabled) and hovering it shows "Select 200 parts or fewer."

Step 7:

  • Nothing opens.

Step 8:

  • The bar reads 200 selected (201 − 1 = 200).

Step 9:

  • The Deactivate button is bright blue (enabled) and no hover text appears: 200 is allowed, only more than 200 is refused.

Step 10:

  • The "Deactivate parts?" confirmation opens and reads "200 parts selected."

Step 11:

  • A green message reads "200 parts updated."
  • The 200 parts leave the Active tab without a page reload and bulk mode ends.
  • Only the 1 part you unticked is still listed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk), story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S2-R8a: “One change takes at most 200 parts. With more than 200 rows ticked, the Deactivate button is disabled, and hovering it shows "Select 200 parts or fewer."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Deactivate or Activate hovered with more than 200 ticked | "Select 200 parts or fewer." | Tooltip on the disabled button”
  • S2-R6: “The checkbox in the header ticks or clears every row loaded in the list. The list loads 30 parts at a time as the user scrolls, so it ticks only the rows loaded so far. The count in the bar shows exactly how many parts will change.”
  • S10-R4: “Raised from the bulk bar, the confirmation opens with "{n} parts selected.", or "1 part selected." for one. Raised from the part dialog, it opens with the part number followed by the description, as they stand in the form, with spaces before and after removed.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
